angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 66,161,070 km at 3181.20 pc = 0.28 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V495 Cyg: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3181.2 +/- 506.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3181.2 +/- 506.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.4007 +/- 0.0177 mas (same row, RUWE 1.32), 22.7 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 95.1 +/- 15.4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V495 Cyg: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 95.1 +/- 15.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 66,161,070 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5375 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 380, Name='V495 Cyg', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
